name: Playwright Tests (qauto)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    env:
      BASE_URL: https://qauto.forstudy.space
      HTTP_USERNAME: guest
      HTTP_PASSWORD: welcome2qauto
      EMAIL: abbiesun806test+1@gmail.com
      PASSWORD: Password123!

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: docker build -t playwright-firefox .

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
            -e BASE_URL=$BASE_URL \
            -e HTTP_USERNAME=$HTTP_USERNAME \
            -e HTTP_PASSWORD=$HTTP_PASSWORD \
            -e EMAIL=$EMAIL \
            -e PASSWORD=$PASSWORD \
            playwright-firefox
